create_adamwmt_optimizer: create an AdamWMT multi-tensor AdamW optimizer instance with custom learning rate and betas
prepare_adamwmt_param_groups: prepare the AdamWMT optimizer by passing param groups to initialize the multi-tensor AdamW
build_adamwmt_from_config: build an AdamWMT optimizer from a config dictionary with lr, betas, eps, and weight_decay
register_adamwmt_optimizer: register the AdamWMT optimizer class with the name adamw_mt using the register_optimizer decorator
review_adamwmt_from_config_validation: review the AdamWMT from_config method that validates betas are floats in the range [0, 1)
